free_text_notes.physician_note: 88-year-old man with former smoker (40 pack-years), osteoporosis, admitted 4/10 with acute exacerbation of COPD. Weaned from BiPAP on day 2; now on room air at rest. The patient reported mild back pain on day 2. This was assessed as positional discomfort from bed rest. Pain resolved with repositioning and a mild pain reliever. No further concern.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Vitals stable this shift. Tolerating diet. 4/16 15:00: Budesonide/formoterol switched to fluticasone/umeclidinium/vilanterol one inhalation daily (was 160/4.5 two puffs twice daily) this morning. Reviewed with patient and wife at 15:00; teach-back correct.
